name: Dorei to no Seikatsu -Teaching Feeling-
source:
I became the guardian of a slave girl had been abused by her last owner. At first things were weird. She was naturally distrusting, but through communication we became friendly.

A bond formed, and we went out together. I bought her clothes, she wore them.

As time passed I began to fall in love with her and she, with me.

This game is about becoming intimate with a slave girl.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162718.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我成為一名曾遭前任主人虐待的奴隸女孩的監護人。起初，一切都很奇怪。她天生不信任他人，但在一次次交談中，我們逐漸成為朋友。

我們建立了羈絆，一起外出。我給她買衣服，她穿上了那些衣服。

隨著時間流逝，我愛上了她，她也愛上了我。

這款遊戲講述如何與奴隸女孩建立親密關係。

[翻譯自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162718.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
